kpis.description_fr: Manufactured = trusses, wall panels, millwork, fenêtres custom. Plus haute marge (~30 % vs ~20 % distribution). Différenciation BLDR.
kpis.description_en: Manufactured = trusses, wall panels, millwork, custom windows. Highest margin (~30% vs ~20% distribution). BLDR differentiation.

kpis.description_fr: 70 % du CA exposé construction maisons individuelles US. Cyclique sur taux hypothécaires. Pression 2023-24 normalisation.
kpis.description_en: 70% of revenue exposed to US single-family construction. Cyclical on mortgage rates. 2023-24 normalization pressure.

kpis.description_fr: ~580 agences réparties dans 43 États USA. Densité maillage = avantage compétitif vs concurrents fragmentés.
kpis.description_en: ~580 locations across 43 US states. Network density = competitive moat vs fragmented competitors.

kpis.description_fr: Roll-up agressif du marché US fragmenté : ~50 deals depuis fusion BMC/BFS 2021. Sources de synergies + part de marché.
kpis.description_en: Aggressive roll-up of fragmented US market: ~50 deals since BMC/BFS merger 2021. Synergies + market share.

kpis.description_fr: Conversion FCF ~65 % de l'EBITDA ajusté. Reflète discipline capex + WC. Permet rachats actions actifs.
kpis.description_en: FCF conversion ~65% of adj EBITDA. Reflects capex + WC discipline. Enables active buybacks.
